title: Standards. Simplified.
voice: We are Team Web Celestials, presenting Pramaan for Smart India Hackathon twenty twenty-six.
caption:
We are Team Web Celestials, presenting PRAMAN
for Smart India Hackathon 2026.

title:
The right standard.
A difficult search.
voice: Procurement officials must identify the right Indian Standards for every product, specification, and tender.
caption:
Procurement officials must identify the right Indian Standards
for every product, specification, and tender.

title: Complexity creates gaps.
voice: Thousands of standards, overlapping scopes, and changing revisions can lead to incomplete specifications and procurement disputes.
caption:
Thousands of standards, overlapping scopes, and changing revisions
can lead to incomplete specifications and procurement disputes.

title: Meet PRAMAN.
voice: Pramaan is an AI-powered procurement assistant that turns product descriptions, technical specifications, and tender documents into relevant standards recommendations.
caption:
PRAMAN turns product descriptions, technical specifications,
and tender documents into relevant standards recommendations.

title:
Recommendations
you can trace.
voice: It connects primary and related standards, highlights amendments, guides certification checks, and identifies specification gaps with supporting evidence.
caption:
Connect standards, highlight amendments, guide certification checks,
and identify specification gaps with supporting evidence.

title:
From documents
to meaning.
voice: First, we extract and normalize document text. A language model understands product parameters, then semantic embeddings represent the requirements.
caption:
Extract and normalize text → understand product parameters
→ create semantic embeddings.

title: Find. Rank. Connect.
voice: Vector search retrieves and ranks relevant standards. Relationship analysis connects allied standards and cross-references for a broader understanding.
caption:
Vector retrieval and ranking find relevant standards.
Relationship analysis connects allied standards and cross-references.

title: Check the context.
voice: The workflow checks versions and amendments, then reviews applicable certification requirements, including BIS product certification, C R S, and hallmarking.
caption:
Check versions and amendments, then review certification requirements:
BIS product certification, CRS, and hallmarking.

title:
Evidence in.
Clarity out.
voice: Retrieval augmented generation combines source evidence with a language model to explain recommendations, relevance, and specification gaps.
caption:
RAG combines retrieved evidence with a language model
to explain recommendations, relevance, and specification gaps.

title: PRAMAN
voice: Pramaan. Faster standards discovery. Explainable, procurement-ready decisions.
caption:
PRAMAN. Faster standards discovery.
Explainable, procurement-ready decisions.
